sources.snippet: MOSS-TTS Family is an open-source speech and sound generation model family from MOSI.AI and the OpenMOSS team. Designed for high-fidelity, high-expressiveness, and complex real-world scenarios, covering stable long-form speech, multi-speaker dialogue, voice/character design, environmental sound effects, and real-time streaming TTS.
